description.value: Kadoya is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, serving sushi and Japanese cuisine in a compact indoor dining room. The restaurant offers online ordering as well as phone-in options, and is wheelchair accessible. It sits in a busy, bikeable urban corridor convenient to cyclists exploring the West End.
